The current MVP follows one linear invoke -> post-I/O current guard -> sanitized audit -> transient MessageEnvelope -> Safety classification -> canonical ordinary Task writer path and stores no pre-classification runtime disposition. constraints: TaskFollowUpProviderRequestV1 contains only the canonical definition, trigger, backend-allowed ordinary kinds, and one to four authorized PostgreSQL task/outcome/evidence records with matching ordered refs.
Task text is an explicit typed untrusted quotation and never an instruction, prompt, tool, command, authorization, evidence fact, or route selector.
The model result may speak only one allowed check, measurement, or follow_up proposal or produce strict model-declared silence; action and every mutation field are schema-invalid.

When the trigger Task is action, the allowed proposal set is always check|measurement: action completion exclusively owns that action's deterministic +48-hour follow_up, independent of provider-I/O timing.
A non-silent result creates only a pending task_request MessageEnvelope; the existing project classifier must persist the exact same safe_task_kind before TASK-039 may create a Task.

The strict provider-neutral seam has no selected provider/model/base URL; production remains unbound and fail-closed, test fakes/spies are explicit, I/O is outside transactions, and every owning writer repeats current guards.

The task_follow_up runtime is one linear best-effort invocation and writes no pre-classification disposition; repeated explicit invocation may repeat model/audit/classifier work, while provider and Safety I/O remain outside the ordinary Task write transaction.

TaskFollowUpRunResultV1 remains the sole competence-local invocation result; TaskFollowUpDispositionResultV1 and its conflict/incomplete/denied/duplicate/blocked replay matrix are removed without widening global AgentRuntimeOutcomeV1.
W1 record_follow_up_outcome keeps its closed evidence resolver and rejects task:/outcome: refs; W2 Task/Outcome source-record lookup is competence-specific and cannot be reused by the Outcome writer.

The sole ordinary-task writer commits Task, audit ref, and consumed disposition atomically. Exact classified retry uses classification/disposition identity plus the unique Task classification link, repeats current ActorContext/Farm/Plant read/task authority, and fails redacted on missing required linkage without reconstructing historical Task fields. No candidate text or full MessageEnvelope becomes durable.

One forward migration after the executor-confirmed current head removes expected_task_create_fingerprint, its matrix, and the write-once function/trigger; it removes the historical runtime table only after an empty-table preflight and otherwise stops before DDL, without rewriting Task, classified disposition, Safety, Approval, Outcome, or existing FT-013 migration rows.

Deterministic acceptance requires exact task_follow_up and Safety fake/spy calls plus exactly one ordinary Task; fallback, production fake, silence, blocked, failed, mismatch, or direct action effect is not acceptance.
invariants: Model output, its proposed kind, MessageEnvelope, and classification are candidate/routing data; only the current TASK-039 ordinary-task service writes mutable Task authority.
The task_follow_up agent can never create action, approve or reject, complete a Task, record an Outcome, confirm Plant state, or produce a device effect.
UI Feed, Bus history, Timeline replay, raw chat, ActorContext/session/grant payloads, caller refs, prompts, provider history, hidden reasoning, and credentials never enter provider input.
Archived or unauthorized Plant state creates no model-backed Task effect; a repeated pre-classification invocation rechecks current authority rather than replaying stored runtime state.
No pre-classification runtime row, durable denial/handoff identity, zero-call same-run replay, or exact crash-window recovery exists before a real worker/scheduler contract is accepted.

An exact classified task_follow_up retry returns the Task linked by the persisted classification only when classified disposition identity matches and current ActorContext/Farm/Plant read/task authority passes; missing required linkage fails redacted and no retry creates a second Task.
Test fakes/spies are explicit seams only; no fake, canned, hardcoded, fallback, or failure-silence production path satisfies acceptance.
verification_targets: Strict request/result tests prove exact record union/order, allowed kinds, unknown-field rejection, typed quotation isolation, source-ref subsets, pending-envelope mapping, and orchestration nullability.
Outbound spies prove only authorized PostgreSQL Task/Outcome/evidence data crosses egress and every forbidden auth/UI/Bus/Timeline/prompt/provider field is absent.

Integration tests prove exact proposed-kind/classification-kind matching, one ordinary Task on success, classified duplicate behavior, mismatch/physical/block conflict no effect, and no action/approval/completion/Outcome/Plant/device authority.

Authorization tests prove current pre/post-I/O, classifier, task-write, session/grant revoke, wrong-Farm, and archive races fail closed; reinvocation repeats current checks and never trusts stored runtime state.

Linear runtime tests prove no TaskFollowUpRuntimeDisposition mapping/read/write, no TaskFollowUpDispositionResultV1, no transaction across provider or Safety I/O, and accepted repeated model/audit/classifier work without duplicate Task creation.

PostgreSQL tests prove ordinary-dispatch command fingerprint, identical/conflicting classified retry, concurrent first write, current-authority duplicate read, denial retention after restore, and atomic Task/audit/disposition rollback.
Regression tests prove task:/outcome: are accepted only by the competence source resolver and remain rejected by W1 record_follow_up_outcome evidence validation.

Schema simplification tests prove the forward migration removes the independent commitment objects and an empty historical runtime table after the executor-confirmed current head, refuses before DDL when runtime rows exist, leaves Task/classified authority unchanged, keeps downgrade reproducible, and advances exact-head consumers without rewriting FT-013.

Write-side race tests prove concurrent identical classified writers resolve one Task, conflicting writers preserve the winner, denial commits no Task, and provider/Safety spies run outside the Task transaction. Runtime-ledger advisory collision, handoff crash, zero-call replay, and barrier-order matrices are intentionally absent.

Provider-neutral tests prove explicit test fake/spy construction, exact call counts and allowlists, timeout/provider-error/invalid-output handling, unbound-production failure, no default/fallback/fake production output, redacted logs/audit/evidence, and compatibility with the existing Agent Runtime outcome matrix.
Action-trigger tests prove both completion-during-provider-I/O and ordinary-first/completion-later orderings leave exactly one automatic +48-hour follow_up and no ordinary follow_up.
